title: mohsine ummat shafie aasia paida hua
body:
mohsine ummat shafie aasia paida hua
fatima ka doosra aarame jaa'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
deene haq ko kardiya purnoor jisne misl mehr
mustafa ka wo chiraaghe khaandaa'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hooro ghulmaa'n kehte hai baaham basad aisho suroor
aaj sardaare jawaanaane jina paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
jisne choosi hai zabaane aqdas qairul wara
aaj wo rutbul-lisa'n moujuz baya'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
fatima ki jaan mehboobe habeebe kibriya
aashiqo maghbool qallaaqe jaha'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
kyu na ho mushkil kusha ka laqte dil mushkil kusha
jo ke mushkil me pukaara ye wahan paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
jiske naame paak se hoti hai taskee'n qalb ko
ghamzado ka wo moee'n roohe rawa'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
jiske darwaaze pe shaahaane jaha'n rakhte hai sab
aaj wo shaahinshahe arsh aastaa'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz uthaata tha sada jis naznee'n ke beniyaaz
wo sawaari doshe qatme mursala'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hai zahoor aaj inka kal abbas kyu paida na ho
shamma jab roshan hui parwaana waa'n paida hua
